name: Triage each prompt
about: Asks a small Claude model through Claude Code to sort each prompt (chat, question, one-off, feature, ops) and adds one [triage] line that tells the director whether to answer inline, hand it to an agent or form a team. Needs the claude command, logged in; without it the hook does nothing.
command: AGENTNET_BIN="{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/bin/agentnet" python3 "{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/hooks/triage.py"

name: Stop heavy work near the usage limit
about: Blocks new agents, sub-agent tool calls and long builds when a Claude usage window (5-hour or weekly) is at 90% or more, so chat keeps working. Reads agentnet's usage data; with no fresh data it lets everything through. Touch the override file it names to allow heavy work for 2 hours.
command: python3 "{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/hooks/usage-guard.py"

name: Remind agents to keep their task list
about: Only for agents that agentnet spawned. Adds a one-line reminder when an agent's task list is still empty after 5 tool calls, or has had no update for 15 minutes. At most one reminder every 10 minutes.
command: python3 "{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/hooks/task-guard.py"

name: Point Claude at the right skill
about: Matches each prompt against your own rules (keywords and patterns) and tells Claude which skill, agent or file to use first. The first run writes an empty rules file, skill-rules.json, in agentnet's config folder; it does nothing until you add rules.
command: python3 "{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/hooks/skill-router.py"

name: Block dangerous shell commands
about: Stops Claude from running rm -rf on / or ~, a forced git push, or git reset --hard.
command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$c" | grep -Eq 'rm -rf (/|~)( |$)|git push.*--force|git reset --hard'; then echo 'Blocked: dangerous command' >&2; exit 2; fi

name: Protect secret and git files
about: Stops Claude from editing .env files, .pem keys, id_rsa keys and anything inside .git.
command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$p" in *.env|*/.env.*|*.pem|*id_rsa*|*/.git/*) echo 'Blocked: protected file' >&2; exit 2;; esac

name: Scan prompts for secrets
about: Stops a prompt that contains an AWS key, an sk- API key, a GitHub token or a private key header.
command: jq -r '.prompt // ""' | grep -Eq 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY' && { echo 'Blocked: prompt looks like it holds a secret' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

name: Log every shell command
about: Appends each shell command Claude ran to ~/.claude/bash-commands.jsonl, so you can look back.
command: jq -c '{at: (now|floor), cmd: .tool_input.command}' >> ~/.claude/bash-commands.jsonl

name: Format files after an edit
about: Runs ruff, gofmt or prettier on a file Claude just edited. A formatter that is not installed is skipped.
command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.go) gofmt -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.ts|*.js|*.json|*.vue|*.md) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0

name: Desktop notification when Claude waits
about: Shows a macOS notification when Claude needs your attention.
command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

name: Desktop notification when Claude finishes
about: Shows a macOS notification each time Claude finishes a turn.
command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude finished" with title "Claude Code"'

name: Git status at session start
about: Gives Claude the git status and the last 5 commits when a session starts.
command: git status -sb 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; exit 0

name: Block git commands that throw away work
about: Stops git clean -f, git checkout -- <file>, git restore ., git branch -D and git stash drop or clear, which delete changes you have not saved.
command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$c" | grep -Eq 'git +(clean +-[a-zA-Z]*f|checkout +(-- |\.( |$))|restore +\.( |$)|branch +-D|stash +(drop|clear))'; then echo 'Blocked: this git command throws away work' >&2; exit 2; fi

name: Block piping a download into a shell
about: Stops commands that download a script and run it straight away, such as curl ... | sh.
command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$c" | grep -Eq '(c[u]rl|w[g]et)[^|]*[|][[:space:]]*(sudo +)?(ba|z)?sh( |$)'; then echo 'Blocked: download piped into a shell' >&2; exit 2; fi

name: Block disk-wiping commands
about: Stops mkfs, dd onto a disk device, diskutil erase and chmod -R 777 on the whole disk.
command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[ ;&|])(sudo +)?mkfs(\.| |$)|dd .*of=/dev/|diskutil +(erase|zero|secureErase)|chmod +-R +777 +/( |$)'; then echo 'Blocked: this command can wipe a disk' >&2; exit 2; fi

name: Stop Claude reading secret files
about: Stops Claude from opening .env files, SSH keys, .pem or .key files and cloud credential files. Example files such as .env.example stay readable.
command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$p" in *.example|*.sample|*.template) exit 0;; *.env|*/.env.*|*/id_rsa|*/id_ed25519|*/id_ecdsa|*/id_dsa|*.pem|*.key|*/.aws/credentials|*/.netrc) echo 'Blocked: secret file' >&2; exit 2;; esac

name: Type-check TypeScript after an edit
about: After Claude edits a .ts or .tsx file, runs the project's own TypeScript check and tells Claude about any errors so it fixes them.
command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ] || exit 0; o=$(node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -30); [ -n "$o" ] && jq -n --arg o "$o" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("TypeScript errors after this edit:\n" + $o)}}'; exit 0

name: Tell Claude the date and git branch
about: Adds today's date, the time and the current git branch to every prompt, so Claude does not guess them.
command: echo "Now: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'). Git branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo none)."

name: Load project notes at session start
about: Gives Claude the start of NOTES.md (or .claude/notes.md) when a session starts or comes back after a compact, so it remembers the project.
command: for f in NOTES.md .claude/notes.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; head -c 4000 "$f"; echo; }; done; exit 0

name: Back up the chat before it is compacted
about: Saves a copy of the full conversation to ~/.claude/transcript-backups before Claude shortens it, so nothing is lost.
command: t=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // ""'); [ -f "$t" ] || exit 0; d=~/.claude/transcript-backups; mkdir -p "$d"; cat "$t" > "$d/$(basename "$t" .jsonl)-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).jsonl"; exit 0

name: Log when a session ends
about: Appends the time, session id, folder and end reason of each session to ~/.claude/sessions.jsonl.
command: jq -c '{at: (now|floor), session: .session_id, reason: .reason, cwd: .cwd}' >> ~/.claude/sessions.jsonl

source.name: disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery (3.9k stars, no licence: idea only, own code)

name: Warn when the conversation gets long
about: After each turn, shows a short note when the conversation passes 150,000 tokens (set AGENTNET_CONTEXT_WARN_AT to change it), so you can run /compact at a good moment. At most one note per session every 20 minutes.
command: python3 "{{AGENTNET_DIR}}/hooks/context-warning.py"

name: Save a git checkpoint after each turn
about: When tracked files changed, saves them as a git stash entry after each turn without touching your files, so you can go back with git stash apply.
command: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; s=$(git stash create "claude checkpoint" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; [ "$(git rev-parse "$s^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse -q --verify 'stash@{0}^{tree}' 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; git stash store -m "claude checkpoint $(date '+%F %T')" "$s"; exit 0

name: Desktop notification when a sub-agent finishes
about: Shows a macOS notification each time one of Claude's sub-agents finishes its job.
command: osascript -e 'display notification "A sub-agent finished" with title "Claude Code"'

name: Desktop notification when Claude waits (Linux)
about: Shows a Linux desktop notification when Claude needs your attention.
command: notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Claude needs your attention'
